name: ninova-mcp
description: İTÜ Ninova ve OBS'yi Claude'a bağlar: dersler, duyurular, ödevler, notlar, transkript, mezuniyet durumu, ders programı ve ders seçimi, hocametre puanları.
long_description: Ninova MCP, İTÜ hesabına senin verdiğin kullanıcı adı ve şifreyle girer ve Claude'un iki sistemi okumasını sağlar. Ninova: derslerin, duyurular, ödevler, notlar, dosyalar, mesaj panosu, yoklama ve yaklaşan teslim tarihleri. OBS (obs.itu.edu.tr): harf notların, dönem dönem ortalaman, 'Mezuniyetime Ne Kaldı', kayıtlı derslerin, haftalık ve sınav programın, transkriptin. Ayrıca giriş gerektirmeyen açık OBS ders programından gelecek dönem açılan şubeleri (CRN, saat, kontenjan) okur, önşart ve eşdeğerlikleri senin planına göre değerlendirip hangi dersleri alabileceğini çıkarır, seçtiğin CRN'lerde çakışma var mı kontrol eder ve notkutusu.com'daki anonim 'hocametre' puanlarıyla şubeleri hocaya göre karşılaştırır. Kimlik bilgilerin cihazının güvenli anahtarlığında saklanır ve yalnızca ninova.itu.edu.tr ile obs.itu.edu.tr'ye (İTÜ'nün girisv3 tek oturum açma sistemi üzerinden) gönderilir; hocametre verisi giriş yapılmadan, herkese açık uçlardan okunur. Hiçbir şey kayıt etmez, değiştirmez; tarayıcı çerezlerini okumaz.

tools.name: auth_status
tools.description: Check whether Ninova credentials are configured and whether a fresh session can be created.

tools.name: refresh_session
tools.description: Force a new login with NINOVA_USERNAME and NINOVA_PASSWORD.

tools.name: get_dashboard
tools.description: Read the Ninova dashboard and summarize courses, recent announcements, assignments, and messages.

tools.name: list_courses
tools.description: List all discovered Ninova courses from the dashboard.

tools.name: get_courses
tools.description: Return all courses visible in the Ninova dashboard.

tools.name: get_course_announcements
tools.description: Return announcements for a specific Ninova course.

tools.name: get_course_class_files
tools.description: List files and folders under the Ninova 'Sınıf Dosyaları' section for a course.

tools.name: get_course_lesson_files
tools.description: List files and folders under the Ninova 'Ders Dosyaları' section for a course.

tools.name: get_course_assignments
tools.description: Return a course's assignment list together with each assignment's full detail page.

tools.name: get_course_info
tools.description: Return structured information from a course's 'Sınıf Bilgileri' page.

tools.name: get_course_sections
tools.description: List the direct course routes exposed on the Ninova course home page.

tools.name: get_course_grades
tools.description: Read the Ninova 'Notlar' page for a course.

tools.name: get_course_message_board
tools.description: Read the Ninova 'Mesaj Panosu' page for a course.

tools.name: get_course_attendance
tools.description: Read the Ninova 'Yoklama' page for a course.

tools.name: get_course_remote_learning
tools.description: Read the Ninova 'Uzaktan Eğitim' page for a course.

tools.name: get_course_overview
tools.description: Return a combined view of a course's sections, announcements, assignments, files, grades, message board, attendance, and remote learning routes.

tools.name: get_dashboard_announcements
tools.description: Return the announcements listed under the Ninova dashboard's aggregated announcements page.

tools.name: get_dashboard_assignments
tools.description: Return the assignments listed under the Ninova dashboard's aggregated assignments page, including full details.

tools.name: sync_all_courses
tools.description: Fetch all visible courses, store a tracking snapshot, and return newly detected changes since the previous sync.

tools.name: get_updates
tools.description: Read the stored Ninova tracking history and return recent detected changes.

tools.name: get_upcoming_deadlines
tools.description: Return assignments whose submission deadline is approaching based on the stored tracking snapshot.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Fetch any Ninova page and return a structured summary of text, headings, links, tables, and attachments.

tools.name: crawl_course
tools.description: Inventory pages and downloadable resources inside a Ninova course tree.

tools.name: download_resource
tools.description: Download a Ninova file or other authenticated resource to disk.

tools.name: snapshot_page
tools.description: Save a structured snapshot of a Ninova page for later comparison.

tools.name: diff_snapshot
tools.description: Compare the current state of a Ninova page against a previously stored snapshot.

tools.name: obs_auth_status
tools.description: Check whether the ITU account can sign in to OBS (obs.itu.edu.tr) via girisv3 single sign-on.

tools.name: obs_refresh_session
tools.description: Force a new OBS login and issue a fresh API token.

tools.name: obs_get_profile
tools.description: Return the student's personal details, student number, faculty, department, advisors, and academic programs.

tools.name: obs_list_semesters
tools.description: List every academic semester available for this student, with the internal semester id and term code.

tools.name: obs_get_graduation_progress
tools.description: Return 'Mezuniyetime Ne Kaldı': the course plan requirements, credits earned vs. required, GPA and internship requirements, every completed course, and every course still missing.

tools.name: obs_get_academic_standing
tools.description: Return the semester-by-semester GPA, semester GPA, credit, and class-level history.

tools.name: obs_get_semester_status
tools.description: Return the academic status snapshot (class level, credits, GPA) for one semester.

tools.name: obs_get_grades
tools.description: Return the final letter grades for one semester, with grade points and pass/fail flags.

tools.name: obs_get_interim_grades
tools.description: Return published in-term grades (midterm, quizzes, final) for a semester's courses, each with the class mean, standard deviation, the student's rank, and the component weight — enough to estimate a letter grade before it is posted.

tools.name: obs_get_course_history
tools.description: Return every graded course across every semester, plus pass/fail counts and the list of failed courses.

tools.name: obs_get_registered_courses
tools.description: Return the courses the student is registered to for one semester, with CRN, place, and time.

tools.name: obs_get_schedule
tools.description: Return the weekly class schedule for one semester, sorted by day and start time.

tools.name: obs_get_exam_schedule
tools.description: Return the final exam dates, times, and rooms for one semester.

tools.name: obs_get_attendance
tools.description: Return the attendance record for one registered class, identified by its OBS class id.

tools.name: obs_get_registration_status
tools.description: Return whether course registration is currently open for the student, per semester.

tools.name: obs_get_internships
tools.description: Return the student's recorded internships.

tools.name: obs_get_announcements
tools.description: Return announcements published in OBS.

tools.name: obs_get_transcript
tools.description: Download the official transcript preview PDF from OBS and save it to disk.

tools.name: obs_check_prerequisites
tools.description: Decide which courses the student may register for, by evaluating each course's published prerequisite expression against their own passed courses, expanded through the course-plan equivalences that cover renamed course codes. Prerequisites reflect the programme's current definitions even for an older plan. Defaults to every course still required for graduation.

tools.name: obs_get_registration_options
tools.description: For every course still required for graduation: which codes satisfy it (including renamed equivalents), whether any of them is offered this term with CRNs and meeting times, and whether the prerequisites are met. The single call to drive course-registration planning.

tools.name: obs_project_gpa
tools.description: Project the cumulative GPA under hypothetical grades, e.g. ["YZV 201E:CC", "ING 201A:BB"]. Models ITU's rule that only the last attempt of a course counts and that equivalent course codes are the same course. Reports whether the reconstruction still matches the GPA OBS itself reports, so a silent model drift is visible.

tools.name: obs_get_elective_pool
tools.description: Return every course that can fill one elective slot of the student's course plan, by group id.

tools.name: obs_get_elective_options
tools.description: For every elective slot the student has not yet filled: the pool of eligible courses, which of them run this term with CRNs and times, and whether the prerequisites are met.

tools.name: obs_api_get
tools.description: Read any /api/ogrenci/... OBS endpoint directly and return the raw JSON. Read-only escape hatch.

tools.name: obs_public_active_term
tools.description: Return the term whose course schedule is currently published on the public OBS pages, with its term code. This is usually the upcoming term, not the one registration still calls current. No login required.

tools.name: obs_public_get_prerequisites
tools.description: Return the published prerequisite expression and minimum completed credits for every course in a branch. These reflect the programme's current definitions, not any one course plan. No login required.

tools.name: obs_public_get_equivalences
tools.description: Return which courses count in place of a plan course, for one course plan and branch. This is how renamed course codes are reconciled across cohorts. No login required.

tools.name: obs_public_list_plans
tools.description: List the course plans published for a programme, with their plan ids. No login required.

tools.name: obs_public_registration_term
tools.description: Return the term the registration system reports as current, which lags the published schedule. No login required.

tools.name: obs_public_list_branches
tools.description: List every course branch code (BLG, YZV, MAT, ...) published for a program level. No login required.

tools.name: obs_public_get_schedule
tools.description: Return every published section for a course branch: CRN, meeting days and times, instructor, room, quota, and remaining seats. No login required.

tools.name: obs_public_find_courses
tools.description: Look up several courses at once by code and return their published sections. No login required.

tools.name: obs_public_check_conflicts
tools.description: Check a candidate set of sections for time clashes and return the resulting weekly timetable. Each selection is {code, crn}; the CRN can be omitted when a course has only one section.

tools.name: hocametre_search_instructors
tools.description: Search notkutusu.com's public 'hocametre' instructor ratings by (partial) instructor name and return matching profiles with their slugs. No login required; the same person may appear as several duplicate profiles.

tools.name: hocametre_get_instructor
tools.description: Return one instructor profile's anonymous student ratings (note sharing, helpfulness, homework load, attendance strictness, teaching skills; each 1-5 with vote counts) and, optionally, the newest student comments. No login required.

tools.name: hocametre_lookup_instructors
tools.description: Resolve several instructor names (as printed in the OBS schedule) to their hocametre ratings. Returns every matching profile, most-voted first, plus a vote-weighted 'combined' score because the same instructor is often split across duplicate profiles. No login required.

tools.name: hocametre_rate_course_sections
tools.description: For each given course code, list every section published in the public OBS schedule for the upcoming term (CRN, times, room, quota, remaining seats) together with its instructor's hocametre ratings, so sections of the same course can be compared by instructor. No login required.
